verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static-site framework. A machine-readable spec of its interfaces (OpenAPI or equivalent) is still a fair question, so the axis applies. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no documentation mentions a downloadable API spec, so there is no evidence it delivers this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
